proposals.evidence: DEDR5373 documents Tamil/Malayalam vāḻai/vāḻa, Kannada bāḻe and Kota vāy vaṇ plantain; DEDR4004 independently documents paḻam/paṇ/paṇṇu fruit, including Irula pammu/pāmu and Kota paṇ. Propose the ordered banana-plant + ripe-fruit components for these surveyed whole words. Their lateral/rhotic/glide, p/h and final-vowel differences are preserved. This is a comparative compound analysis for this survey lect, not a claim that every spelling or lect is printed in DEDR; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. More heavily contracted forms without two identifiable constituents are excluded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR7 explicitly gives Tamil akaṅkai/aṅkai, Kannada aṅ-gey, Kodagu aŋgay and Tulu aṅgai palm, under akam inside; DEDR2023 gives kai/kay/key hand. Propose ordered inside + hand components, with contraction of akam in the compound. Survey minority-lect forms are comparative extensions and retain their original vowels and hand-stem endings.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered inside + hand: DEDR698 explicitly gives Malayalam uḷḷam inside/mind, matching the current *uḷḷ-am parent, and DEDR2023 gives kai/kay/kayyi hand. Survey uḷḷam-kai and assimilated uḷḷaŋ-kai/uḷḷaŋ-gai retain both constituents. This uses the actual uḷḷam formation; it does not override the separate hold on house words under this narrower parent.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered male + children/people constituents. DEDR399 āṇ male or DEDR4395(a) peṇ female supplies the first member; DEDR4616 explicitly gives Tamil makkaḷ human beings/children, Malayalam makkaḷ children and Kodagu makka children; the survey makka/makkaḷ ending is preserved. This is a comparative compound analysis of the entire response, not a claim that DEDR prints the survey compound.
